ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white/light-grey) localized pixel clusters representing scars and epibionts.

Dense clusters of high-intensity, high-frequency texture are located at the extreme lateral distal margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters at the tips create a jagged, non-linear boundary that deviates from the smooth geometric curve of the primary lobe edges.
